Isolated Inhale

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Download NowName your own price
WARNING

This is a development version of the game that does not fully reflect the intended experience and may contain critical errors.


GAMEPLAY

You are a spaceship pilot in an abandoned sector. Your job is to complete tasks and service stations. In order to survive and reach the next destination, you need to monitor your ship and its systems during the flight.


SOUNDTRACK

The game has its own original soundtrack composed by f11, so feel free to stream or record gameplay!


LINKS

🔥 Patreon
Opportunity to receive unique perks or suggest adding your own item and give this game more chances to survive.

Sneak peeks, community-created mods, custom content and much more.

📖 Community Wiki
All the available information about the game (WIP).


FAQ
Q: Are there any plans to add multiplayer?A: Multiplayer implementation only makes sense after release on Steam. Current gameplay was designed for singleplayer, so adding coop also requires  lot of things to consider and rework.
Q: The game won't start on MacOSA: Try launching the game though the official Itch.io app: https://itch.io/app
OR
execute this:
chmod -R +x [path_to_game_file]
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine [path_to_game_file]

Epic. Regarding the sound bug, I tried to reproduce it, and here’s what I can say.

It occurs the moment I open the door leading to the long corridor that leads to my ship. I checked this on the door at the base station. BUT, what plays an important role here is which save I loaded. The one on the docked ship or in the station’s lobby. If you load the save in the lobby, the door will cause the sounds to disappear. By the way, it’s probably worth adding a check to see whether the player has already taken the suit or not. Instead of blocking access to the capsule room if the player doesn’t have the suit. Just in case someone doesn’t want to wear the suit while walking around the base.

Hello!

I want to say that "Isolated Inhale" is an absolutely amazing game, and the atmosphere is incredible. It has already taken third place in my personal top of favorite games — right after Minecraft and Barotrauma! The graphics are wonderful, the physics are great, and the motto "You can take anything that isn't screwed down, and if it is screwed down, you can unscrew it" is just brilliant. I have been dreaming of a game like this my whole life.

I am a writer myself (currently editing 5 of my books) and I look at game worlds through a creative lens. I am completely charmed by the design of the White Creature, which I affectionately nicknamed "Kocheryzhka" (Cabbage Stump). It would be incredibly interesting to learn more about its biology, anatomy, and lore! Since I am passionate about literature and biology, I would be very happy to share my work with you. If you like to read, I would love to offer you a look at my books — perhaps they might inspire you or give you some new ideas.

I have also created a YouTube channel dedicated to Minecraft, Barotrauma, Factorio (with Primordialis), and, of course, Isolated Inhale! I love sharing my passion for these games, and my very first video is going to drop in just two days. If you'd like to check it out, here is the link: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgtVgZl3q5_y9LgFX1Nq7bA.

Here are a few thoughts and suggestions from a dedicated player:

  • Routine Work Mode: It would be awesome to have a peaceful "everyday workday" game mode where nothing extreme happens. Just flying around, dismantling the station, carrying boxes, and enjoying the meditative process and physics.
  • Co-op: I would love to play this game with my sister. A cooperative mode would literally be a dream come true for me.
  • Localization: I really hope that the Russian language will be added to the game someday. Immersing myself in this thick ambient atmosphere in my native language would be even more amazing.

Thank you for your hard work and inspiration, keep it up!

Best regards, Yura_X
